title.zh: Kimi推出面向游戏开发与创意工作流的AI Agent解决方案
title.en: Kimi launches AI-agent solution for game development and creative workflows

current_state.zh: Moonshot AI's Kimi launched a game development and creative-work solution that uses AI agents to operate Unity, Unreal Engine, Blender and Godot across the full pipeline from gameplay prototyping through publishing and live-ops, including a Unity China demo where the agent worked 20 hours unsupervised and delivered a playable native project.
current_state.en: Moonshot AI's Kimi launched a game development and creative-work solution that uses AI agents to operate Unity, Unreal Engine, Blender and Godot across the full pipeline from gameplay prototyping through publishing and live-ops, including a Unity China demo where the agent worked 20 hours unsupervised and delivered a playable native project.

updates.title_zh: Kimi进军游戏工业，让AI Agent接管从开发到运营的整条工作流
updates.title_en: Kimi进军游戏工业，让AI Agent接管从开发到运营的整条工作流
updates.what_changed_zh: Moonshot's Kimi launched a game-development and creative-workflow solution in which AI agents operate Unity, Unreal Engine, Blender and Godot to design gameplay, build 3D assets, modify existing projects, run and test builds, and support publishing, live-ops and AI-driven NPC dialogue.
